g.title: J8
g.text: Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside).

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. VIN-SD: left channel. VIN-GAIN: 6 dB. C1 470 uF and C2 100 nF across VIN/GND. SPK- is not GND.

g.title: SP1
g.text: Adafruit 3351 enclosed 3 W 4 Ω. Amplifier + to speaker +. JST-PH 2.0 cable into 3006 screw terminals. Keep under 10 cm.

g.title: U2
g.text: 3.3 V only. Bottom port faces down. SEL jumpered to GND (left).

g.title: U3
g.text: Provisional module; E4 deferred. JD-VCC jumper absent. VCC 3.3 V; JD-VCC 5 V after F2. C3 100 uF from JD-VCC to GND. IN LOW energizes coil. COM1/NO1 switch isolated 12 V. Logic GND is common with Pi.

g.title: F2
g.text: In series with relay JD-VCC; C3 is downstream.

g.title: U5
g.text: Custom circuit in button-input.md. Buffered active-low outputs; six 10k pull-ups. RETURN and GND joined on board. Shared ground; no system galvanic isolation. Connector layout pending.

g.title: BTN
g.text: Four switch contacts plus common return. Populate positions 1-n. Each contact closes SWn to RETURN; field wires terminate at U5, not at GPIO.

g.title: J_CSI
g.text: Standard-Mini 200 mm ribbon. Contacts face the PCB.

g.title: CAM1
g.text: IMX708. 15-pin camera end of the Standard-Mini cable.

g.title: J12
g.text: From indoor GST18E12-P1J adapter via installation cable. Terminal names; connector part pending. Return is separate from Pi GND.

g.title: F1
g.text: In the 12 V+ lead to RELAY1 COM1.

g.title: JOUT
g.text: To external effeff A7 strike. D1 1N4007 at coil: cathode STRIKE+, anode STRIKE-. External cable length is installation-specific.
